title: Two brothers of gangster Shankar Pandey arrested in connection with Vinayak murder case
summary: The Vinayak murder case has taken a significant turn as two brothers of gangster Shankar Pandey have been arrested by the police. The arrests were made in connection with the case, which is still ongoing. The incident occurred in Purnia, Bihar, and has raised questions about the role of organized crime groups in the region.
summary_points: The Vinayak murder case is a high-profile investigation into the killing of a businessman in Purnia, Bihar.
Two brothers of gangster Shankar Pandey have been arrested by the police in connection with the case.
The arrests were made on the basis of evidence collected from the crime scene and other sources.
The incident has raised concerns about the involvement of organized crime groups in the region.
The police are still investigating the case and gathering more evidence.

framing_hi.center: केंद्रीय समाचार एजेंसियां विनीत हत्याकांड में पुलिस द्वारा गिरफ्तार किए गए दो भाइयों और अभी भी चल रहे जांच को ध्यान में रखती हैं। उन्होंने बिहार में संगठनात्मक अपराध समूहों की भूमिका पर भी प्रकाश डाला है।
